description: Am I behind CGNAT? Give the router WAN/Internet IP (and optionally the public IP websites see). Returns behind_cgnat (yes / likely / no / unknown / not_applicable), the WAN address type and range, and a plain-language answer with next steps. 100.64.0.0/10 = CGNAT; a private WAN IP = CGNAT or a second router; WAN equal to public IP = no CGNAT.

public_ip.description: Optional: the public IP the user sees on a what-is-my-IP site. Do not use the agent's own IP.

wan_ip.description: Router WAN / Internet IPv4 address, e.g. 100.64.12.5

name: check_cgnat
